MERGE injects kg_prompt preds (by hash_id, KGGen OIE schema) into each cell's composed eval-set (already carries gold tkgu_triples + 405B llm_assessment) under alias kg-prompt; the 405B GT filter is applied downstream by the aggregator (assessors below) -> recall denominator = 405B-true golds, matching Table 3.
